'''Marrovia''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Marrovia system/Legends|Marrovia system]], a part of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Pinooran Spur/Legends|Pinooran Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the [[Planet/Legends|world]] to the [[Kli'aar system/Legends|Kli'aar]] and [[Ladarra system/Legends|Ladarra systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Marrovia was known for its type of hardy, fatty [[Marrovian pig|pigs]]. The animals were [[Diet/Legends|fed]] in giant [[Farm/Legends|farms]] and then processed in rendering stations, of which there were many on the world's surface. Beings on Marrovia experienced a stench that was hard to believe.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marrovia was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-5.<ref name="TEA" />
